newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Nov deficit down 20.5 pct on National basis.
newsitem.headline: Spain Nov deficit down 20.5 pct on National basis.

text.p: Spain's budget deficit on a National Account basis dropped 20.5 percent to 2.156 trillion pesetas in the first eleven months of the year from 2.713 in the year-ago period, the Economy Ministry said on Monday.
This was the first time figures were given in these terms.
The deficit on cash basis declined in the period by 12.5 percent to 2.132 trillion pesetas, versus 2.437 trillion in 1995.
In November alone the deficit was 37.5 billion pesetas from 166 billion in the year-ago month and 55.2 billion in October.
Taking into account the surprise budget shortfall discovered in July, the deficit on a cash basis rose 6.1 percent to 2.586 trillion pesetas from 2.437 in the eleven months to November.
